name: new_v1_f5c_unibo_complete_bout_increment_v1
path: Oracle-labelled complete native gesture bouts >=1 second, each entire bout compressed to 32 equal-duration multichannel RMS envelope bins, then L2-normalized per time and centered at start. Only order-one and order-two signatures, no time channel.
training: Per-user source-only balanced trial weights. Day1-4 fits inner classifier and Day5 fits its temperature; Day1-5 refits classifier. G5 feature extractors and G5 parent probabilities come from frozen parent. F5c and combined classifiers use identical fixed logistic settings C=1, balanced classes and frozen source-only standardization.
evaluation: Day6 is validation; Days7-8 are descriptive final. All arms score identical complete held bouts. G5 predictions must reproduce both frozen parent arrays, including ordered bout IDs, within numerical tolerance.
boundary: Offline oracle-segmented complete UniBo four-muscle, processed-200 Hz bouts. Not short-window detection, automatic onset/offset segmentation, live device behavior, or the user's 250 Hz eight-channel hardware. Do not promote F5c from final-only gains.
